title: Set your preferences first
lede: The first thing to do in the portal. Two fields, one Save button.

blocks.title: Set both font fields to Arial 12
blocks.text: ExamSoft ships with its own defaults. JABSOM standardizes on Arial 12 so that questions written by different course directors over nine years still look the same when they land in one assessment. Do this before you write or import anything.

items.d: Hover the gear icon at the top right of any portal page, then choose **My Preferences**.

items.t: Go to the Question Creation tab
items.d: First of the four tabs across the top.
Under General Options (All Question Types), choose **Arial**, size **12**.
Under Multiple Choice Answers, choose **Arial**, size **12**.
Click **Save Preferences**. Revert to Default discards the change, so avoid that button.

blocks.alt: ExamSoft Legacy portal My Preferences page on the Question Creation tab. Red annotations circle the gear account menu at top right with My Preferences selected, the Question Creation tab, the Question Fonts dropdown set to Arial size 12 under General Options for All Question Types, the Answer Fonts dropdown set to Arial size 12 under Multiple Choice Answers, and the Save Preferences button at the bottom. The account holder name beside the gear icon has been pixelated.
blocks.caption: My Preferences, Question Creation tab. Both font controls set to Arial 12, then Save Preferences.
blocks.note: The account name at top right is pixelated. It showed a former OME staff member.

blocks.text: Leave the other tabs alone. **Partial Credit** and **Number of Answer Choices** are decisions you make per question while writing, so there is no reason to change them globally now.

items.label: Legacy Portal: Set Your Grade Preferences
items.note: Shows how to reach My Preferences from the gear icon. Covers the grade export tab rather than Question Creation.

blocks.text: ExamSoft does not appear to publish a Legacy article for the Question Creation preferences tab specifically. The steps above come from the OME onboarding documents and the screenshot. Confirm whether a vendor article exists, or leave this as JABSOM-documented only.
